'''SuriTech Foodstuffs''' was a company that specialized in the production of [[tox detector]]s,<ref name="GFT" /> such as the [[Disposable Toximeter Patch]]<ref name="PSG" /> and the [[Ez1 Analyzer]].<ref name="GFT" /> Although these devices were meant to test one's food in order to prevent food [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]], the devices could also be used to test the air content in [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to prevent chemical poisoning or detect [[Life support/Legends|life support]] failures.
